evidence: task/task.toml:20-24 [environment]: build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096 - byte-identical to template task.toml:20-24 and to the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:56-60; diff of task.toml vs template differs only in [task]/[metadata] identity fields (lines 5-15). No docker_image, allow_internet or allowed_hosts key anywhere in task.toml (grep rc=1). No secret literal under [environment]; the only credential-shaped lines are [verifier.env] ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" (template placeholder, expected per SKILL.md Known false positives) and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public" (line 38) is correct per profile and not flagged. Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile SHA256 0a75419e...67d1 equals template environment/Dockerfile SHA256 exactly; pinned base node:22-bookworm-slim, globally installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, no ENV/ARG secrets, no COPY of solution/ or tests/. Secret grep (api key/secret/token/password/sk-/private key/AKIA/ghp_/xox) over task/environment and task.toml found only the documented demo password 'Hireops!2026' at environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:11, which is an expected demo credential per profile, not a live secret. 'Nothing that secretly needs an install': solution/app/package.json pins exactly express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 (matching the image), the solution's require() set is only those two plus Node built-ins (crypto, fs, path, node:http, node:worker_threads) and local modules, and solve.sh performs no npm/apt install (it only copies app/ to /app and resets the DB). 2 CPUs / 4 GiB is sane for a Node+SQLite app with native better-sqlite3 preinstalled (no compile at solve time). Broken-config counterexample considered: a task setting cpus=0.5/memory_mb=512, adding docker_image, or inlining a real sk- key - none present. Conforming-alternative counterexample: an agent solution that wants extra npm packages can fetch them since the network is public (quality-checks.md:45 note), so the posture does not unfairly fail a different conforming implementation. Static configuration row; no runtime measurement is required for this verdict, and none is claimed (no agent-image build log was inspected).
